production.note: US model years 2016 to 2018. First: BMW NA's release 'The All-New 2016 BMW M2' (13 Oct 2015), US launch in "spring of 2016". Last: "The 2019 BMW M2 Competition replaces the BMW M2 Coupe" (bmw-us-2019-m2-competition-release); Kelley Blue Book lists a 2018 "M2 Coupe 2D" with "365 @ 6500 RPM" (kbb-2018-m2).

aspiration.note: Single TwinScroll turbocharger: "In the new 6-cylinder inline gasoline engine, this comprises a TwinScroll turbocharger, High Precision Direct Injection, variable camshaft timing (Double-VANOS) and VALVETRONIC variable valve lift control." The twin-turbo S55 arrived with the separate M2 Competition.

transmission.note: "The all-new BMW M2 comes as standard with a six-speed manual gearbox"; the seven-speed M Double Clutch Transmission (M DCT) was optional.

powerHp.note: Quote: "Engine power" "365@6500" (technical data table); text: "365 bhp at 6,500 rpm". Still 365 hp for 2018 per kbb-2018-m2.

weightLb.note: Coupe with the 6-speed manual, 2016 model. Quote: "US Curb weight" "3505" (M2 DKG) and "3450" (M2 manual) from the technical data table. Kelley Blue Book also gives "3,450 pounds" for the 2018 manual (kbb-2018-m2).

sources.title: The First Ever 2019 BMW M2 Competition (press release with specifications)
